text:
Nothing documented happened to Paul McCartney on November 9, 1966. That date is the one the "Paul is dead" rumour gives for a fatal car crash after which he was supposedly replaced, and there is no evidence for it. The shared note is wrong: McCartney kept recording and performing with the Beatles through 1967 and beyond, so his life did not end in November 1966. I did not re-check the sources for this answer, so my earlier citations are unverified here.

CONFIDENCE: 85
